question: In a certain code language, 'CEKF' is written as 'ZBHC' and 'NCPF' is written as ‘KZMC’. How will 'JROG' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : **(3) is subtracted from the position value.** So, • 'CEKF' is written as 'ZBHC'
